scope: Chromium on isolated loopback synthetic portal invoice and offer, light and dark themes, A4 PDF using real print CSS
limitations: One short synthetic invoice and one short synthetic offer; no production/customer data or provider calls.
Print-media DOM geometry, both -layout/-raw extracted PDF text, and actual visual review of all eight rendered single-page PDFs; long/multipage clipping remains untested.
A4 with zero custom margins, no headers/footers, printBackground true; other printers, margins, long/multipage documents, and engines are untested.
steps: Navigate synthetic public capability route in fresh context.
Confirm real portal GET response and selected theme.
Emulate print and record first-visit UI visibility.
Produce first-visit A4 PDF; extract text.
Reject optional cookies through visible UI, switch back to print, inspect print CSS and overflow.
Produce actual A4 PDF, extract document and monetary text, render PDF to PNG.
Verify content-order -raw PDF extraction as well as -layout extraction; verify actual PDF media dimensions reported by pdfinfo.

observations: Actually viewed all eight PDF-page PNG renders: four consent-dismissed document PDFs plus all four first-visit PDFs.
Consent-dismissed invoice and offer PDFs have readable dark text on white paper in both themes. Long buyer name wraps cleanly, the six-column table fits, and no document cutoff/overlap is visible.
Net 125,00 zł, VAT 28,75 zł and gross 153,75 zł are fully visible in all four document PDFs.
Every first-visit PDF visibly prints its cookie banner, including settings/reject/accept controls and privacy links. Banner is light in light theme and dark in dark theme.
Cookie banner does not overlap these short single-row documents. Longer documents could intersect the fixed banner; that has not been tested.

firstVisitIssues.issue: First-visit cookie banner and its three UI buttons print in the PDF. CookieConsentBanner lacks print:hidden/no-print. Portal document actions are correctly hidden.
firstVisitIssues.reproduction: Open an invoice or offer portal in a fresh profile with no consent cookie, then print/save as A4 PDF before choosing cookie preferences.
firstVisitIssues.impact: Cookie website UI is included in the PDF. It does not overlap this tested short document.
firstVisitIssues.potentialFix: Apply no-print or print:hidden to the consent banner; no source change made because final app is frozen.
